concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal-paypal-troubleshooting]] — 2026-09-15 PayPal Web Drop-in/Components `/payments` troubleshooting for overlay action, details callback, required smart button and currency/intent/merchant-ID errors; console errors leave an open offer.
warnings: Scope is Web Drop-in/Components using /payments; the page does not diagnose billing agreements, recurring tokens, funding eligibility or capture/refund execution.
The capture/authorize intent fix is specifically qualified to Web Drop-in v3.13.0 or earlier (raw lines 78–86).
